title: eh_os_contract graph overlay v1
description: What the log says over a graph.v1 document, for a period: numbers keyed by the ids of the document's nodes and relations, never a copy of the facts. Only the numbers the conformance report computes; nothing a reader needs to recount.

contract.description: The id: of the contract it is of.

module.description: The contract's module, for a reader in the code.

version.description: The contract version the log was read against.

document_digest.description: The digest of the graph.v1 document this overlay joins onto: a reader joins it only onto that one.

since.description: The period's start, inclusive; null when unbounded.

until.description: The period's end, inclusive; null when unbounded.

nodes.description: Numbers by the id of a node of the document.

relations.description: Numbers by the id of a relation of the document, or of one defined under observed. A relation no step, transition or move ends at has no entry, and so have the two issues relations (phase start and run) of a process manager issuing one command on one event both as a run starts and during it: the report reads that as one step, and the log does not record which phase a command was issued in.

observed.description: Relations the log shows and the contract does not declare, in the document's shape, by type.

domain.description: The module of the domain it is of.

version.description: The domain version the log was read against.

document_digest.description: The digest of the graph.v1 document this overlay joins onto: a reader joins it only onto that one.

since.description: The period's start, inclusive; null when unbounded.

until.description: The period's end, inclusive; null when unbounded.

nodes.description: Numbers by the id of a node of the document.

relations.description: Numbers by the id of a consumed_by relation of the document: what crosses between two contracts.

observed.description: Relations the log shows that the documents do not declare, in the document's shape, by type: none between contracts.

event_numbers.description: An event: how often the log holds it in the period, whatever run, if any, each falls in.

runs.description: A process, or a domain's contract with one: its runs in the period.

step_numbers.description: A step of the contract, on the relation that ends it: how often it was taken in the period (null for an effect, which leaves nothing in the log when it acts), what waits there and what fails, by source, and whether the report counts it as never taken or as not taken yet because what it starts from is still on its way.

taken.description: Occurrences: the events its command appended, or the commands its reaction issued, accepted or rejected.

waiting.description: Events an ordered consumer has not reached, timers not fired, effect jobs not run.

failing.description: Commands that failed where the step runs (each failed command once), effect jobs discarded, the consumer's subscription stopped.

oneOf.description: Where the consumer stopped, and why.

untraversed.description: The conformance report's reading of the step: true exactly when the report lists it as never traversed in the period.

pending.description: The report's not yet: the step was not taken because what it starts from is still on its way.

step_by_trigger.description: A relation several steps end at — a policy handling several events, drawn as one issues: each step's numbers under the id of the event it starts from. No total, as the report gives none. An entry is this or step_numbers, never both.

by_trigger.description: By the id of the triggering event, in the document.

traffic_numbers.description: Between two contracts: how many of the consumed events the log holds in the period, how many wait at the consumer's steps that start from them, and whether any fails.

transition_numbers.description: A lifecycle's transition: how often it was taken in the period, and whether the report counts it as not yet (an aggregate still stands where it can be taken) or never.

undeclared.description: A move a lifecycle does not allow that happened anyway, in the shape of the document's relations: from the status the aggregate stood in to the one it stayed in — the unit's id where it stood in none yet — by the event.

undeclared_numbers.description: A move the lifecycle does not allow: how often it happened in the period.

unit_numbers.description: An aggregate with a lifecycle: how many of them had an event in the period.
